axial_ends.py.adaptation: Original equal-height summary; published common profile and relative output paths.

validation_metrics.py.adaptation: Original per-case Dice/IoU and pooled precision/recall formulas; only the three study classes, with null representing absent-class NaN.

athena_analysis/spatial.py.adaptation: Original scientific image-analysis functions retained unchanged.
